checks: Every real PNG decodes with exact reference pixel/dimensions on forward and reverse gallery walks; known tile geometry stays stable.
Offscreen image payloads/URLs release while every gallery tile remains.
Native Tab reaches the next image and restores its decoded content.
Open dialog and returned keyboard focus keep the shared image alive offscreen; blur permits release.
Known placeholders match decoded image geometry at narrow and wide native window sizes.
Duplicate local references share one Blob; removing one reference preserves the other.
Changing the source closes the old dialog, releases its resource and decodes the new source.
A missing file reports a local error; Retry reads the repaired file and renders it.
Each explicit Retry is fresh even while another duplicate reference holds a failed attempt.
Closing a pending preview and leaving its tile discards the late file response without recreating a Blob.
Remote image references remain explicit external-open buttons and create no remote image element.
Local SVG references decode through an owned Blob URL rather than a retained text/data URL.
optimized.scope: Private Linux source Electron. Scroll request to decoded/pixel-checked DOM includes IPC/polling/canvas verification; not physical input-to-paint. Fixed settling waits are outside visit times. Natural and explicit diagnostic cohorts are separate processes. Complete app-tree PSS only; no model/GPU-driver memory claim.
